The percentage of type E cars sold out of the total number of cars sold was minimum in which year?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Percentage of E/A (2007) = (9)/((15 + 12 + 10 + 8+ 9) )times 100 =(9)/(54) x 100 = 16.67 %

Percentage of E/A (2008) = (12)/((10 + 10 + 13 + 12 + 12) )times 100 =( 12)/(57) x 100 = 21.05 %

Percentage of E/A (2009) = (18)/((25 + 10 + 12 + 19 + 18))times 100 = (18)/(84) x 100 = 21.42 %

Percentage of E/A (2010) = (12)/((12 + 18 + 13 + 12 + 12))times 100 = (12)/(67) x 100 = 17.91 %

Percentage of E/A (2011) = (14)/((19 + 12 + 12 + 14 + 14))times 100 = (14)/(71) x 100 = 19.71 %

Percentage of E/A (2012) = (15)/((15 + 14 + 14 + 14 + 15) )times 100 = (15)/(72) x 100 = 20.83 %

The percentage of type E cars sold out of the total number of cars sold was minimum in 2007 year.

**Hence, the correct answer is option 2).**
